name: yemen-legislation-platform
description: منصة تشريعات يمنية محلية تحفظ النصوص والنسخ الزمنية ومصادرها

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @ylp/api" "npm run dev -w @ylp/web" "npm run dev -w @ylp/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ylp/api && npm run build -w @ylp/worker && npm run build -w @ylp/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @ylp/api && npm run test:unit -w @ylp/web
